heading: Exclusive right to name, seals, emblems, and badges
lead: The corporation has the exclusive right to use the name “Board for Fundamental Education” and seals, emblems, and badges the corporation adopts.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 3070636:516.July 19, 1954, ch. 536, § 16, 68 Stat. 492. The word “sole” is omitted as included in “exclusive”. The words “as representing such corporation” and “lawfully” are omitted as unnecessary.
